title: Fix mechanism descriptions (judge call 1 of 2)
description: What each later fix repaired, described from the patches ALONE. Produced by a call that is never shown the reviewer findings, so that the description cannot be conditioned on what a reviewer happened to say. Its output is passed verbatim into call 2; see docs/oracle-bundle-contract.md.

fix_mechanisms.description: Exactly one entry per fix supplied.

mechanism.description: What was wrong with the code, under what condition, with what consequence - not what the patch touched. An honest 'no identifiable defect repair' is preferred to an invented mechanism, since everything downstream compares against this as though it were real.
